title: Namma caxaaxuwih sigeenit
intro: barkat mangom elle caxtah tan baaxol, ayyunti inki adda namma qaxmeqe caxaaxuwih acwat ruffa iyya. Ken mano yallih fayxih sumaaqak sugte, takkay immay ken aydaadi gadda gey lowsiisih yan waqdi, inkih tan abaabissah tan maritteh sarrimaane le asta takkeh tan milaagitte fanah gexak sugte.
clues: Nanu sahli kee mangah baaxol xuwaawak sugne ummattak sugne.
Ni Rabbi namma qaxmeqe caxaaxuwih arac neh yeceeh, kulli gammik caxâ baxa leeh.
Nanu gadda gacisnam amrisneh sugne, takkay immay nanu gadda sinna doorneeh wonnah nuduureh.
kaxxa karawwad ni baaxoh mano yacee lee yibbixe.
nanu ninni qellat abneh sugne waqdi, karawwad bakaqtem kee weeqi lee fiyteh.
nek inki adda-lush caxaaxuwih arac ciggiileh qeero caxâ baxaay, tamarisks kee dagoo lote coox.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Ni caxaaxuwi arac qeero le caxâ baxaa kee dagoo cooxut milaagimte
Nanu baaxo ardi angoyyih addat yanxuqeh sugne.
Nanu damaaqe kee ceray fanah milaagimne
Nanu kaxxa weeqi addat culneh sugne.
outcome.answer: Ni caxaaxuwi arac qeero le caxâ baxaa kee dagoo cooxut milaagimte

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
